page.overview:
Who is Mable?

Mable is a character appearing in , and is one of the five scientists working for Team Flare. She reappears in , where she serves as the director of the Pokémon Research Lab.

Mable has teal-blue hair in oval shaped pigtails on the sides of her head, with technologically blue advanced glasses covering her eyes and teal-blue lipstick. She sports a red and white long-sleeved shirt with red shoulder pads and a tie that is about the same shade blue as her hair. She also wears a red and black skirt with a belt that has the Team Flare symbol adorning it. She also wears short red tights can be seen underneath and red and black tall high heeled boots.

Five years, her appearance has changed a lot in her clothing as she has discarded her Team Flare outfit for a white lab coat, a black long-sleeve dress with yellow and red circle crisscross patterning, opaque black tights or stockings, gray and white shoes with heels, though she keeps her teal-blue tie from her original outfit. Her hairstyle has changed slightly with her oval-shaped pigtails now placed lower and behind her ears, her lipstick is now red instead of teal-blue, and she now wears a pair of see through glasses reminiscent of lab goggles, revealing her eyes which are the same shade as her hair and tie. She also has a white Rotom Phone which she uses to conduct her work on.

Mable doesn't battle in Pokémon Legends: Z-A.
